title: ImageResize removes EXIF data, with "Remove metadata" turned off
author: Hypano

judgment.rationale: Open PR #47888 directly targets the reported JPEG re-encode metadata-loss path and explicitly closes this issue. Duplicate issues #47729 and #47972 have already been resolved in favor of this tracker.
evidence: The report and multiple follow-ups describe EXIF/GPS/camera metadata disappearing when metadata removal is disabled.
The latest substantive defect confirmation says the problem remained on 0.100.2.
PR #47888 is open and declares 'Closes: #47693', with JPEG EXIF reconstruction and metadata-preservation tests.
PR #47888 changes Image Resizer ResizeOperation plus codec and metadata helpers and covers GPS, descriptive EXIF, dimensions, corrupted EXIF, and strip-metadata behavior.
Closed #47729 and #47972 were explicitly marked duplicates of #47693.
judgment.recommended_action: Track review and validation of PR #47888 rather than start duplicate design work.

fix_assessment.rationale: The active PR directly implements metadata preservation for the affected JPEG re-encode path.

issue_context.summary: Image Resizer removes JPEG EXIF metadata, including GPS and camera data, while the setting to preserve metadata is selected; an open PR directly implements the needed preservation and EXIF-rebuild path.
known_information: The primary report uses 100% resolution, JPEG quality 70%, overwrite enabled, and metadata removal disabled.
Multiple commenters reproduce the loss through 0.100.2.
The issue is assigned to daverayment.
PR #47888 is open, directly closes the issue, and lists focused metadata regression coverage.
The newest issue comments discuss an external workaround rather than a change in PowerToys behavior.
inferences: The quality-driven fresh JPEG encode path is the likely loss boundary; PR #47888's re-encode and EXIF reconstruction scope matches it.
The external workaround does not replace validation of the PowerToys implementation.
issue_context.analysis: There is specific active ownership and a public implementation with extensive stated test coverage. A competing design would duplicate the PR and obscure its review boundary.
initial_investigation: Read the full issue body and all fourteen comments.
Read linked duplicate #47729, #47972, and open PR #47888.
Inspected current src/modules/imageresizer/ui/Models/ResizeOperation.cs; its fresh-encoder path explicitly selects preserved metadata when RemoveMetadata is false.
Reviewed targeted Image Resizer history, including the JPEG quality change that can select fresh encoding.
Searched live Image Resizer EXIF reports and found the linked duplicate chain.
